title: Rebuild Market Intel — G-Man Intelligence Signal Dashboard

requirements.summary: Remove Advanced Analytics, Live Price, and Crypto News sections from Market Intel page
acceptanceCriteria: Advanced Analytics, Live Price, and Crypto News sub-sections are not rendered anywhere inside the Market Intel page.
No console errors related to missing components caused by the removal.
Other standalone pages that use those components remain unaffected.

file_operations.description: Remove all references to Advanced Analytics, Live Price, and Crypto News sections including imports, component usage, and any hooks exclusively serving those sections. Keep other page functionality intact including the passcode gate, signal generator placeholder, poll creation, and Market Pulse voting sections.

requirements.summary: Preserve passcode gate and ensure access to G-Man Intelligence signal generator, poll creation, and live Market Pulse voting after unlock
acceptanceCriteria: Visiting /market-intel without unlocking shows only the passcode entry screen.
Entering the correct passcode reveals all three sections: signal generator, poll creation, Market Pulse.
Entering an incorrect passcode shows an error and keeps the gate locked.
The unlock state persists across re-renders within the same browser session.

file_operations.description: Verify and preserve the existing passcode gate mechanism. Ensure sessionStorage-based unlock state persists across re-renders. After successful unlock, render three main sections: G-Man Intelligence signal generator (to be implemented), poll creation (using existing useCommunityVoting), and Market Pulse voting (using existing backend queries). Use the backend method grantMarketIntelAccess for passcode validation.

requirements.summary: Build G-Man Intelligence signal generator UI flow with market category selection, asset selection, and timeframe selection
acceptanceCriteria: Four market category buttons are displayed (Top 10 Crypto, Top 10 Forex, Gold, Silver).
Selecting a category reveals the individual assets for that category.
Seven timeframe buttons (1M, 5M, 15M, 30M, 1H, 4H, 1D) are shown after a category is selected.
The Generate Signal button is disabled until both an asset and a timeframe are selected.
Selecting a different category resets the asset and timeframe selections.

file_operations.description: Create a multi-step wizard component for G-Man Intelligence signal generation. Step 1: Display four category buttons (Top 10 Crypto, Top 10 Forex, Gold, Silver). On category selection, display the specific assets for that category: Top 10 Crypto: BTC, ETH, BNB, SOL, XRP, ADA, DOGE, AVAX, DOT, LINK; Top 10 Forex: EUR/USD, GBP/USD, USD/JPY, USD/CHF, AUD/USD, USD/CAD, NZD/USD, EUR/GBP, EUR/JPY, GBP/JPY; Gold: XAUUSD; Silver: XAGUSD. Step 2: Display seven timeframe buttons (1M, 5M, 15M, 30M, 1H, 4H, 1D). Maintain component state for selectedCategory, selectedAsset, and selectedTimeframe. The Generate Signal button is enabled only when both selectedAsset and selectedTimeframe are set. Changing the category resets selectedAsset and selectedTimeframe. Use a clean card-based layout with gold accent buttons matching the RBS theme.

Import and render the SignalGeneratorWizard component in the unlocked Market Intel page. Position it as the first major section after the passcode gate. Wire the onGenerateSignal callback to trigger the backend generateSignal call and display the result card.

requirements.summary: Display G-Man Intelligence signal output card with signal label, confidence percentage, indicator summary, and trend direction
acceptanceCriteria: After clicking Generate Signal a loading state is shown.
On success, the signal card renders all six fields: signal label, confidence %, indicator summary, trend direction, asset name, timeframe.
Strong Buy / Buy are styled in green tones; Sell / Strong Sell in red tones; Neutral in grey/amber.
A confidence progress bar or percentage badge is clearly visible.
The card header reads 'G-Man Intelligence'.
On backend error, a user-friendly error message is displayed instead of a blank card.

file_operations.description: Create a React Query mutation hook that calls the backend generateSignal function with symbol and timeframe parameters. Return SignalResult containing signal (StrongBuy | Buy | Neutral | Sell | StrongSell), confidencePct, indicatorSummary, trendDirection, and calculatedAt timestamp. Handle loading, success, and error states. Use the useActor hook to access the authenticated backend actor.

Create a signal output card component that displays G-Man Intelligence results. Include the generated image 'frontend/public/assets/generated/gman-intelligence-logo.dim_256x256.png' in the card header with the text 'G-Man Intelligence'. Display the signal label with color coding: StrongBuy/Buy in green (e.g., bg-green-500/10 border-green-500), Sell/StrongSell in red (e.g., bg-red-500/10 border-red-500), Neutral in grey/amber (e.g., bg-amber-500/10 border-amber-500). Show confidence percentage as both a numeric badge and a progress bar. Display indicatorSummary as readable text and trendDirection as a labeled field. Show the asset name and timeframe for reference. Handle loading state with a spinner and error state with a user-friendly message. Use glass-morphism card styling consistent with the RBS dark-gold theme.

Wire SignalOutputCard to display results from the useGenerateSignal mutation. Pass the mutation result to SignalOutputCard after the user clicks Generate Signal in the SignalGeneratorWizard. Position the output card immediately below the wizard. Show loading spinner while mutation is pending, display the signal card on success, and show error message on failure.

requirements.summary: Implement real-time Market Pulse voting with live percentage bars and poll creation access
acceptanceCriteria: Three voting buttons (Bullish, Bearish, Neutral) are displayed in the Market Pulse section.
Clicking a button records the vote via the backend and immediately updates the displayed percentages.
The tally auto-refreshes every 10 seconds without a full page reload.
Percentages always sum to 100% and are displayed as progress bars with numeric labels.
A user who has already voted in the current session sees their selection highlighted but cannot vote again.
Poll creation UI from the existing CommunityVoting feature is accessible within the unlocked Market Intel page.

file_operations.description: Create a React Query hook for Market Pulse voting. Implement a query for getMarketPulseTally that auto-refetches every 10 seconds. Implement a mutation for voteMarketPulse that accepts sentiment (Bullish, Bearish, Neutral) and invalidates the tally query on success. Track the user's vote in component state or sessionStorage to prevent duplicate voting in the same session. Use the useActor hook to access the backend actor.

Create a Market Pulse voting component that displays three voting buttons (Bullish, Bearish, Neutral) and live percentage bars. Use the useMarketPulseVoting hook to fetch the current tally and cast votes. Disable the button the user has already clicked and highlight it to show their selection. Calculate and display percentages from the VoteTally (bullish, bearish, neutral, total) ensuring they sum to 100%. Render progress bars with numeric percentage labels for each sentiment. Use gold accent colors for active selection, green for Bullish, red for Bearish, and grey for Neutral. Auto-refresh the tally every 10 seconds using the query's refetchInterval.

Import and render the MarketPulseVoting component in the unlocked Market Intel page. Position it after the signal output card section. Ensure the existing poll creation UI from useCommunityVoting is also rendered and accessible in the unlocked page. Maintain clear visual separation between Market Pulse voting and poll creation sections.

Each link opens in a new browser tab.
The WhatsApp channel link URL is exactly https://whatsapp.com/channel/0029VbB6FHV59PwWv9wIE93P.
The Telegram link URL is exactly https://t.me/RBSuperior.
The Presale & Airdrop WhatsApp link dials +92 329 4238997 via wa.me.
The email link uses mailto:design.crafters.official@gmail.com.

file_operations.description: Create a Contact Information section component displaying four contact links: WhatsApp Channel (https://whatsapp.com/channel/0029VbB6FHV59PwWv9wIE93P), Telegram (https://t.me/RBSuperior), Presale & Airdrop WhatsApp (+92 329 4238997 via https://wa.me/923294238997), and Contact Email (mailto:design.crafters.official@gmail.com). Render each as a clickable button or link with appropriate icons (use lucide-react icons: MessageCircle for WhatsApp, Send for Telegram, Mail for email). All links must open in a new tab (target='_blank' rel='noopener noreferrer'). Use gold accent styling consistent with the RBS theme and organize links in a responsive grid or column layout.

Import and render the ContactInfoSection component at the bottom of the unlocked Market Intel page, after all other sections (signal generator, signal output, Market Pulse voting, poll creation). Ensure it is only visible after the passcode gate is unlocked.

requirements.summary: Apply professional real-time AI trading dashboard visual theme with dark background, gold accents, and full responsiveness
acceptanceCriteria: The Market Intel page uses a dark background with gold accent colours.
All sections are clearly delineated with card containers.
Numeric signal values and percentages use a monospaced or technical font style.
The page layout is fully responsive and usable on screens from 375px wide upward.
No visual overlap, broken layout, or unstyled elements exist on the page.

file_operations.description: Add utility classes for monospaced or technical typography using existing font families or by importing a monospace font (e.g., 'Roboto Mono', 'JetBrains Mono'). Ensure dark background and gold accent color CSS variables are accessible throughout the app. Do not change existing Tailwind base directives or theme variables; only extend with additional utility classes if needed.

Apply a dark background (e.g., bg-background or bg-gray-950) to the page container. Wrap each major section (passcode gate, signal generator, signal output, Market Pulse, poll creation, contact info) in a glass-morphism card with subtle borders or glows using gold accent colors (e.g., border-[rgb(var(--gold))] shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(255,215,0,0.15)]). Use a monospaced or technical font class (e.g., font-mono) for all numeric values (confidence percentages, vote percentages, signal confidence). Ensure responsive layout with padding and spacing adjustments for mobile (min-width 375px) and desktop (lg breakpoint). Test for visual overlap and broken layouts at all breakpoints.

Apply dark-gold theme styling to category buttons, asset buttons, and timeframe buttons. Use gold accent colors for selected/active states (e.g., bg-[rgb(var(--gold))] text-black) and dark neutral colors for inactive states (e.g., bg-gray-800 text-gray-300). Ensure buttons are touch-friendly on mobile (min-h-12 min-w-20). Use a clean card container with glass-morphism effect and responsive grid or flex layout.

Apply monospaced or technical font to numeric values (confidence percentage, timestamp). Use dark card background (e.g., bg-gray-900/80) with gold accent borders. Apply color-coded backgrounds and borders for signal labels: green for Buy signals (bg-green-500/10 border-green-500), red for Sell signals (bg-red-500/10 border-red-500), amber/grey for Neutral (bg-amber-500/10 border-amber-500). Ensure responsive layout with proper spacing and text wrapping.

Apply dark-gold theme with glass-morphism card styling. Use monospaced font for percentage values. Style voting buttons with color-coded accents: green for Bullish, red for Bearish, grey for Neutral. Highlight the user's selected vote with a gold border or glow. Ensure progress bars are clearly visible with appropriate color fills and responsive widths.

Apply dark card background with gold accent borders. Style contact links as buttons with icons, using gold hover effects. Ensure responsive grid layout that stacks vertically on mobile and displays in a 2x2 or 4-column grid on desktop.
